name: dna
headline: The *DNA* of a hive
sub: Five kinds of artifact. Nothing else.
say: Five kinds of artifact compose everything. Hypercomb calls them its D N A — Distributed Network Artifacts. Layers: the structure — each one an immutable snapshot linking to its children by signature. Resources: the content bytes — images, text, files. Bees — short for beehaviors — small modules of code that give the hive life. Dependencies: the libraries those bees rely on. And content: everything a tile carries. All five are content-addressed, immutable, merkle-versioned, and shareable across the network. Your entire hive is just these five kinds, combined.
